touristAppeal.label: Not a tourist town

townGuide.headline: Priory echoes and a long village beside the Welland
townGuide.intro: Follow the older village spine around St James’s Church and the river, looking for surviving historic details before an easy outdoor extension.
perfectFor: A gentle local discovery, strongest when combined with neighbouring Market Deeping.
